title: Dental PPO Plans Schedule of Benefits: Annual Maximum and Deductible
content:
The six Dental PPO Plans of Cascade Mutual Dental & Vision (Cascade Dental PPO Preventive 750, Value 1000, Classic 1250, Plus 1500, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500) carry the following annual maximum and deductible provisions. Amounts are in US dollars per benefit period.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Annual maximum per person | 750.00 | 1000.00 | 1250.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | 2500.00 |
| Individual deductible | 0.00 | 75.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 25.00 |
| Family deductible maximum | 0.00 | 225.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 | 75.00 |
| Deductible waived on preventive services | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Annual maximum applies to preventive services | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |

**Annual maximum per person.** The most the plan pays for that person's covered services in a benefit period, subject to the preventive-exclusion switch and to rollover.

**Individual deductible.** The amount per person per benefit period applied to basic and major services before coinsurance; 0.00 means the plan has no deductible.

**Family deductible maximum.** Once the enrollments of one subscriber have together applied this much to deductibles in a benefit period, no further deductible is taken for any of them; 0.00 means no deductible. On every Dental PPO plan with a deductible, the family deductible maximum is three times the individual deductible (Value 1000: 75.00 and 225.00; Classic 1250, Plus 1500 and Premier 2000: 50.00 and 150.00; Elite 2500: 25.00 and 75.00).

**Preventive deductible waiver.** When the waiver applies, no deductible is taken on preventive-class lines. It applies on all six plans.

**Annual maximum and preventive services.** Where the schedule shows "No" (Premier 2000 and Elite 2500), plan payments on preventive-class lines are not posted to the annual maximum and are still paid after the maximum is met. Where it shows "Yes", preventive payments count against the annual maximum like any other payment.

### Reading the schedule
- Preventive 750 shows 0.00 for both deductibles, so no deductible is ever taken on that plan.
- On a hypothetical Classic 1250 family of three in which two persons have each applied 50.00 in the same benefit period, the family has applied 100.00 of its 150.00 family maximum.
